newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines sees 6-6.5 pct GNP growth in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Philippines sees 6-6.5 pct GNP growth in Q1 1997.

text.p: Philippines Socio-Economic Planning Seceretary Cielito Habito said on Wednesday he expected the country to post between 6.0 to 6.5 percent growth year-on-year in gross national product (GNP) in the first quarter of 1997.
He told reporters that the figure would be reached despite some expected adjustments due to an increase in wages and a likely rise in oil prices.
He said the country expects between 7.0 to 8.0 percent GNP growth in all of 1997. Inflation in the year is expected to come in between 6-6.5 percent from 8.4 percent in 1996, he said.
